title: [CQ-C11] Context integration and hardening
description:
Objective: Verify stale context, new helpers, incomplete semantic analysis, session deltas and recipe mismatch across roles.

Deliverable: Context integration and hardening. This is task C11 of the approved full CQ rollout; consume this contract, not the whole reference document.

Scope boundaries: implement this behavior and its regression tests only. Later activation, other platform/client consumers and other task behaviors remain out of scope unless named here. Approved full CQ-01–CQ-08 rollout from the interactive implementation plan (2026-10-24). CQ-01 is already landed. Use original Moe source; daemon owns state, wrappers own host Git writes. User selected Moe-provisioned LOCAL Linux VMs (not cloud CI), coding/QA and checks isolated, and exact designated LOCAL BRANCH delivery. Strong profile stays disabled until isolation, evidence and client gates pass. Preserve legacy behavior and existing dirty bytes. Never directly edit .moe. No second revision authority, scheduler, graph database or native memory database.

Verification command (fresh, exit0 required): cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test

Dependency aliases (wired by Moe task ids after import): C10.
definitionOfDone: Zero planner calls occur only for valid reuse/eligible recipe paths.
No approval or scope boundary is bypassed.
Fresh verification `cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test` exits0 and its output is supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: No direct .moe edits; no Git-write commands by agents; wrappers own landing.
Do not enable verified-local or claim isolation until all requisite implementation and certification gates pass.

comments.author: architect-4c57a52b
comments.content:
Docs and integration hand-forward from CQ-C01 (task-fef5ca57, plan rev 1). Verify against what landed before writing anything.

Default and full get_context task reads gain `packetManifest`:
- `version`.
- `provenance`: task {id, planRevision}, epic, project, and candidate (when one exists).
- `sections`: entries {path, mandatory, status (C02's served|truncated|omitted|missing), reason, count}.
  - MANDATORY_SECTIONS are never role-trimmed or truncated.
  - Omissions are explicit: role-trim, compacted comments/chat, capped commits/siblings/rejections.
- `complete`.
- `limitations`, sorted. 'no-repository-source' stays until C10 serves C02's provider.
- `budget`: {limitChars, mandatoryChars, status within|overflow, requirement expand|restructure}.

There is also a new optional `packetBudgetChars` input (1000..250000, default 100000), refused when invalid, never clamped.

The manifest sits inside F06's packetId digest and never grants approval.

For C11, document all of this in docs/MCP_SERVER.md (get_context) and docs/SCHEMA.md. C06 (deltas) and C10 (targeted guidance) build on these section paths and codes.
